text:
Ana C.: quick heads up — docs PR #412 is blocked. preview failed linkcheck + one SDK snippet shows the wrong default for `stream`. can someone help unblock?

docs-bot: Preview build failed — linkcheck errors:
  - 404 on /sdk/python/latest/generate referenced from /docs/quickstart.md
  - orphan anchor(s) in embeddings.md
Full log: https://ci.internal/preview/412

Samir: I can take a look. The python snippet shows `stream=False` as the example default; our SDK historically had mixed defaults. which API surface are we documenting here?

Ana C.: it's the /v1/chat/completions wrapper in quickstart. current code block is:
```python
client.generate("tell me a joke", stream=False)
```
that mismatch might confuse folks if SDK or server defaults changed.

Mira: if defaults shifted, better to make examples explicit. suggest changing to `stream=True` for chat examples (or show both) and pin the SDK link to a versioned path instead of `latest`.

Jarrod: I'll push a tiny commit: explicit `stream` kwarg + change /sdk/python/latest -> /sdk/python/0.18.3/ (we pin to the latest released doc tag). anyone ok merging once linkcheck re-runs? need one more docs approval.

Samir: ack, but quick runtime check first: does the hosted API enable streaming when model supports it even if `stream` omitted? @eng-runtime can you confirm behavior so docs are accurate.

eng-bot: Routing to #eng-runtime and pinging @matt (runtime lead).

Matt: Confirming: server-side default is `stream=false` for backward compatibility. however some SDKs historically set `stream=True` as sugar for chat helpers. SDKs are inconsistent. recommendation: docs must explicitly set the kwarg in examples and we should file an SDK/runtime follow-up to harmonize.

Mira: :thumbsup: sounds good. docs will be explicit. after the versioned link and snippet update CI should pass. i'll approve once preview is green.

Jarrod: pushed commit (fix/link-version-and-snippet). docs-bot, please re-run preview.

docs-bot: Build queued. Preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood/412/ (linkcheck running)

Ana C.: thanks — plan is to merge once preview passes and Mira gives approval. opening a follow-up issue for SDK defaults consistency (assigning Samir).

Samir: taking it — i'll open an issue and loop in runtime.

Mira: approving now. note for reference: run local preview with `./scripts/run-preview --site docs` to reproduce linkcheck locally before pushing next time.

Ana C.: awesome, thanks everyone — unblocking PR after CI passes.
